I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. No deadline has been agreed for the Tansley Parcel signed order form. The only date anyone has given is 25 August, from Pree in this channel on 14 October.

That date had already passed when she posted. I asked her then whether she meant a different date or year, and she hasn't replied. I told Hollis to wait for her confirmation before putting it on the account sheet, and asked Pree in the thread to confirm.

I checked that Hollis is a member of #central-team before reading it, so everything I quoted is something he can see. A deadline date isn't a money figure, so it was fine to share with him.
